title: SQL Day 1 Coding Arena — Retrieval & Analytical Outputs

questions.scenario: A morning sales review needs a transaction extract.
questions.request: Return order ID, customer, category, sales, and profit for every order.
questions.validation: Correct columns and row-level values from orders.
questions.business_objective: Help the sales manager make a decision from the order-level data without changing the source dataset.
questions.required_output: Return order ID, customer, category, sales, and profit for every order.
constraints: Use the orders dataset at its stated transaction grain.
Return only fields required by the stakeholder request.
Keep calculations reproducible and use the exact business rule stated in the request.
questions.success_criteria: Correct columns and row-level values from orders.
questions.decision_use: Use the resulting output as an auditable input for the retrieval review.
